scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint mobile/src mobile/app mobile/tests server/src server/test packages/contracts/src --max-warnings=0
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @raahi/server run build
scripts.db:setup: npm --workspace @raahi/server run db:generate && npm --workspace @raahi/server run db:migrate && npm --workspace @raahi/server run db:seed
